description: Bounded integer-valued profile of TSVC's vbor nested-product loop.

pinned_source.attribution: The TSVC source comments attribute its non-four-digit codelets to David Callahan, Jack Dongarra, and David Levine, Test Suite for Vectorizing Compilers.
pinned_source.license_note: No explicit license grant was found in the pinned TSVC source or repository material reviewed. Ports are independent implementations of the bounded loop behavior; no upstream source code or comments are reused and no upstream license or endorsement is claimed.

contract.operation: For each index, compute the source's four nested products from six input values and add their product to a checksum.
contract.arithmetic_type: The source uses binary64 double. Bounded integer-valued inputs and all intermediates are exactly representable; the ports use signed i64 arithmetic with a maximum checksum below 94,372,000.
contract.traversal: Visit indices in ascending order and accumulate each source-shaped product once; source timing repetitions and dummy calls are excluded.

input.encoding: n, followed by six contiguous arrays A through F, each of length n
